Design and rationale of the CLEAR SYNERGY (OASIS 9) trial: A 2x2 factorial randomized controlled trial of colchicine versus placebo and spironolactone vs placebo in patients with myocardial infarction. Patients experiencing myocardial infarction (MI) remain at high risk of future major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE).
